turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
o. We do not ship to the United Kingdom or French overseas territories.

For Switzerland, the price includes Swiss VAT, logistics costs and customs fees. If the carrier asks you to pay customs fees, please send us the corresponding PDF invoice and we will settle it directly with the carrier.

For other destinations, any applicable taxes or customs charges depend on the destination and are shown or communicated during checkout. You can find the full details here: https://www.tediber.com/livraison
turns.replyText:
Yes, we ship to several European countries, including Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Monaco, Vatican City and San Marino. We do not ship to the United Kingdom or French overseas territories.

For Switzerland, the price includes Swiss VAT, logistics costs and customs fees. If the carrier asks you to pay customs fees, please send us the corresponding PDF invoice and we will settle it directly with the carrier.

turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
depends on the products and destination:

Small parcels such as bed linen, duvets and pillows: usually 48–72 hours.
A mattress alone in Metropolitan France, without old-bedding collection: 24–48 hours.
Bulky items, or orders including old-bedding collection: around 8–10 days in France.
European deliveries: approximately 72 hours, to the building entrance.

The earliest available date for your specific order is shown during checkout and in the “Ma livraison dès le…” section on each product page.

turns.q: What's your return and refund policy?
Are any items final sale or non-returnable?
turns.replyTail:
14 calendar days from receipt.
Promotional gifts: if you return the main item, the free gift must also be returned for the refund to be approved. Returning the gift alone does not result in a refund, and keeping it may lead to its value being deducted.

Returned products must not be damaged. If old bedding was collected during delivery, it cannot be returned later because it is sent for recycling. Purchases made in a Tediber boutique follow a manual return process rather than the online portal.
turns.replyText:
Some products have specific return conditions rather than being final sale:

Bed linen and mattress protectors: return within 30 days of receipt. They are outside the 100-night trial.
Mattresses and other bulky products: covered by the 100-night trial from delivery.
Gift cards: 14 calendar days from receipt.

turns.q: What payment methods do you accept for an order?
turns.replyTail:
We accept the following payment methods for online orders:

CB, Visa, Mastercard and American Express
PayPal, where available for your destination
Instalment payments for eligible orders between €50 and €8,000. Payment in 3 or 4 instalments is interest-free; longer instalment plans may include fees or interest.

The exact options available for your order are displayed at checkout.

turns.q: How do I contact your support team if I have an issue with an order?
turns.replyTail:
You can contact our support team in this chat, by email at hello@tediber.com, or by phone (free call).

Opening hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 7:00 pm, and Saturday, 9:00 am to 6:00 pm.

For a delivery-related issue, please report it within 72 hours of delivery.
